exposure: Hysteroscopic resection for cesarean scar defect (CSD)
Laparoscopic defect repair for cesarean scar defect (CSD)
outcome: Incidence of postoperative complications (fever, pelvic pain)
Serious obstetric complications (placenta implantation, uterine rupture)
cohort: The study included 154 patients with non-severe cesarean scar defect (RMT >= 3 mm) treated at a Maternal and Child Health Hospital in Hubei Province, China, between January 2019 and May 2022.
finding: Hysteroscopic resection showed advantages over laparoscopic defect repair, including minimal trauma, shorter surgical time, less intraoperative bleeding, shorter hospital stay, lower treatment costs, faster postoperative recovery, lower incidence of complications, and a higher re-pregnancy rate.
followup_time: Up to 12 months after surgery for menstrual outcomes, and until obstetric outcomes for re-pregnant patients.
